notes.title: Final Release!
notes.notes:
Hi all, thank you for participating in the Cyber Lemur community! I wanted to let you know that Cyber Lemur is finally complete and is available for purchase. The final game includes 5 new levels that weren't in the early access version as well as some bug fixes. Please feel free to post any comments, questions or concerns about this version. I hope you enjoy the new content!

Cheers,
Brett
